actions_dates_ck.name: actions_dates_ck
actions_dates_ck.value: "action_items"."end_date" is null or "action_items"."start_date" is null or "action_items"."end_date" >= "action_items"."start_date"

activities_ranges_ck.name: activities_ranges_ck
activities_ranges_ck.value:
("activities"."executions_per_period" is null or "activities"."executions_per_period" >= 0) and ("activities"."units_per_execution" is null or "activities"."units_per_execution" >= 0)
    and ("activities"."time_avg_min" is null or "activities"."time_avg_min" >= 0) and ("activities"."time_min_min" is null or "activities"."time_min_min" >= 0) and ("activities"."time_max_min" is null or "activities"."time_max_min" >= 0)
    and ("activities"."season_high_factor" is null or "activities"."season_high_factor" between 0 and 10) and ("activities"."season_low_factor" is null or "activities"."season_low_factor" between 0 and 10)
    and ("activities"."simultaneous_people" is null or "activities"."simultaneous_people" between 1 and 50)
    and ("activities"."load_share_pct" is null or "activities"."load_share_pct" between 0 and 1) and ("activities"."rework_pct" is null or "activities"."rework_pct" between 0 and 1)
    and ("activities"."wait_min" is null or "activities"."wait_min" >= 0) and ("activities"."travel_min" is null or "activities"."travel_min" >= 0) and ("activities"."rework_min" is null or "activities"."rework_min" >= 0)

opportunities_scales_ck.name: opportunities_scales_ck
opportunities_scales_ck.value: coalesce("improvement_opportunities"."impact_score",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("improvement_opportunities"."ease_score",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("improvement_opportunities"."effort_score",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("improvement_opportunities"."cost_score",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("improvement_opportunities"."risk_score",1) between 1 and 5

risk_scales_ck.name: risk_scales_ck
risk_scales_ck.value: coalesce("risk_assessments"."impact_operational",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("risk_assessments"."impact_economic",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("risk_assessments"."impact_labor",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("risk_assessments"."impact_legal",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("risk_assessments"."impact_service",1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("risk_assessments"."probability",1) between 1 and 5

staffing_ranges_ck.name: staffing_ranges_ck
staffing_ranges_ck.value: ("staffing_entries"."headcount" is null or "staffing_entries"."headcount" between 0 and 500) and ("staffing_entries"."weekly_hours" is null or "staffing_entries"."weekly_hours" between 0 and 84)

study_parameters_ranges_ck.name: study_parameters_ranges_ck
study_parameters_ranges_ck.value: "study_parameters"."work_days_per_week" between 1 and 7 and "study_parameters"."reserve_pct" between 0 and 1 and "study_parameters"."low_load_threshold" <= "study_parameters"."overload_threshold"
